trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
trophies.guide: 1) Earn the other 54 trophies in this guide. 2) The platinum pops automatically once the last one lands — there is no extra task of its own. 3) Use the Roadmap tab to see which chapter still has trophies left, and the Next Up planner to pick your next target.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
trophies.guide: 1) Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end. 2) Follow the on-screen objectives — this is the game's first story mission, so it cannot be missed. 3) The trophy unlocks as the mission's closing scene plays.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
trophies.guide: 1) Finish every story mission in Chapter 1 in order. 2) The chapter ends with a closing mission — play it through to its end. 3) The trophy pops when the chapter-complete screen appears; nothing in the chapter can lock you out of it.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
trophies.guide: 1) Work through Chapter 2's story missions in order. 2) Finish the chapter's final mission. 3) The trophy unlocks when Chapter 2 completes; it cannot be missed as long as you keep playing the story.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
trophies.guide: 1) Play through Chapter 3's story missions in order. 2) Complete the chapter's closing mission. 3) The trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen; story progress alone earns it.

sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
trophies.guide: 1) Finish the story, then work through the in-game 100% checklist: missions, activities, collectibles and exploration. 2) Check the game's own completion stat after each session so nothing is left behind. 3) The gold trophy pops at 100% — this is the longest grind in the game, so save it for last.

sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
